messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: datadog.ingest.delay spike detected for logs/metrics in us-west-2. 95th percentile ingestion lag > 180s for last 5m. Auto-page sent to #incidents and PD.
Sara T.: ack — I'm on call. checking console + service health now. can someone confirm if customer-facing latency/errors present?
Mike L.: no 5xx spike on the API frontends, health checks all green. dashboards look stale — graphs haven't updated for ~4m.
Anil P.: confirming: traces are showing backfill but live dashboards stale. this is an observability blindspot, not yet a user-visible outage but super risky while we investigate.
datadog-bot: Datadog status: Investigating — https://status.datadoghq.com/incident/ingest-delays (posted automatically).
Sara T.: good, thanks. immediate mitigation plan:
- open ticket with Datadog with account details
- switch critical alerts to CloudWatch fallback (temporary)
- enable increased local debug logs for inference and routing services
- start persistent local logging (k8s sidecar) for core paths

Mike L.: I can flip alert routing. going to create a temporary monitor in infra that duplicates the query to CloudWatch.
Zoe (Support Eng): I opened support case with Datadog (case #DD-987654). tagged as high. included ingress samples + account org id. asked for ETA and whether this is limited to us-west-2.
Anil P.: good. I'll also ping our Datadog AM and Slack channel we have with their ops.

Sara T.: while we wait: enable extra logging on the model-inference pods. use this command:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/inference-worker LOG_LEVEL=debug
kubectl -n inference logs -f deploy/inference-worker | tee /tmp/inference-debug.log
```
We should also start a live export of those logs to an internal S3 bucket for post-analysis:
```
aws s3 cp /tmp/inference-debug.log s3://redwood-incident-logs/1920004321-debug.log
```

Mike L.: created fallback monitor and routed to PagerDuty. also adjusted silences on Datadog alerts so we don't get duplicate noise while Datadog is investigating.
ops-bot: NOTE: created incident channel archive and pinned runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/observability-blindspot

Anil P.: Contacted AM and DM'd the on-call at Datadog. they say they're seeing delayed ingestion on our ingest cluster and have an internal remediation in progress.
Sara T.: status update for stakeholders: no customer-facing errors observed, but telemetry is delayed — we have limited visibility. recommend status-amber to CS and SRE on-call.
Zoe (Support Eng): Datadog support replied — initial ETA 25-40m for mitigation on their side, will provide updates. sharing their internal incident link in the ticket.

Mike L.: action items I'm doing now:
- ensure critical paging works off CloudWatch -> PD
- spin up local metrics-exporter for request counts (prometheus) to avoid missing rate signals
- snapshot current dashboards and note missing data windows

Sara T.: handoff — I'm going offline in ~8m. Anil, can you take on-call for the incident until Datadog confirms resolution? I'll hand over session and logs.
Anil P.: taking over. current checklist saved in thread and runbook. will keep PD escalations on. if Datadog doesn't show progress in 30m, we'll start throttling noncritical telemetry to reduce queue and prioritize customer metrics.

oncall-sre: logged action: reduce sampling on debug logs to 10% and enable priority queueing for core metrics. command used:
```
kubectl -n infra apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: telemetry-config
data:
  sampling: "0.1"
  priority-queues: "core:high, diagnostic:low"
EOF
```

Sara T.: thanks team. I'll post a short incident update to #customer-facing-status and to the Ops mailing list before I step off. Anil keep PD notified and add timestamps to logs for postmortem.
Anil P.: will do. updating case DD-987654 with our mitigation steps and linking internal ticket INT-1920004321.

ops-bot: REMINDER: create postmortem ticket (P2) if Datadog ETA extends beyond 1h or if any customer impact is confirmed.

Zoe (Support Eng): Datadog just sent a patch to their ingest fleet; they report partial recovery for some customers in us-west-2. monitoring for fully cleared status. I'll paste their update here once they confirm.

Mike L.: starting to assemble artifacts: logs, dashboard snapshots, ticket links, and the runbook steps.
Sara T.: excellent. small ask for handoff: Anil, drop a short summary in this thread when you take full ownership so I can mark my handoff clear.
Anil P.: taking full ownership now. summary: Datadog ingestion delay affecting dashboards in us-west-2; no user-facing errors; switch to CloudWatch fallback; debug logging enabled; support case DD-987654 opened; monitoring Datadog for recovery. continuing active monitoring.
ops-bot: thread closed for primary responder. will re-open on activity or manual unpause.
